recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-39150 unless the work group later changes Questionnaire.derivedFrom semantics or the way core should reference extension-pack extensions.
issue_request: FHIR-39150 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core change request for Questionnaire.derivedFrom, raised in R4 and applied for R5. It asked to clarify that derivedFrom can represent relationships ranging from fully compatible derivation to looser inspiration and to create a standard derivationType extension for precise cases.
initial_application: Core commit f8d89d749d6a7c46299e85b47bae4269a6a3129e added a Questionnaire.derivedFrom comment saying the element covers relationships from 'somewhat inspired by' to 'fully compliant with' and linking to questionnaire-derivationType. FHIR Extension Pack commit 60e73b11631f519530273413ff2d8bfe73836d2d created the derivationType extension artifacts.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml is build-scope source. FHIR-39606, already represented on the combined branch, corrected the same element's short description to 'Based on Questionnaire'. Later FHIR-41451 revised the questionnaire-derivationType extension in the extension pack, confirming the later corrections are external to core.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source change was made. The current core source already carries the requested guidance and extension link, and the extension-pack source carries the companion extension plus later approved corrections. The minor existing 'extensionthat' spacing typo is editorial and does not alter implementer understanding enough to justify a source-changing reconciliation commit.
